def VTask.subtypePreimage {α : Sort u} {β : Sort v} (p : α → Prop) [DecidablePred p] (x₀ : {a : α // p a} → β) : {x : α → β // x ∘ Subtype.val = x₀} ≃ ({a : α // ¬p a} → β) := by
  have h_forward : {x : α → β // x ∘ Subtype.val = x₀} → ({a : α // ¬p a} → β) := by
    intro f
    have h₁ : f.val ∘ Subtype.val = x₀ := f.property
    -- Define the forward direction by restricting f.val to {a : α // ¬p a}
    have h₂ : ({a : α // ¬p a} → β) := fun ⟨a, ha⟩ => f.val a
    exact h₂
  
  have h_inverse : ({a : α // ¬p a} → β) → {x : α → β // x ∘ Subtype.val = x₀} := by
    intro y
    -- Define the inverse direction by extending y to all of α using x₀ on p a
    have h₁ : α → β := fun a => if h : p a then x₀ ⟨a, h⟩ else y ⟨a, by simpa [h] using Classical.by_contradiction (fun h' => by simp_all)⟩
    -- Verify that h₁ ∘ Subtype.val = x₀
    have h₂ : h₁ ∘ Subtype.val = x₀ := by
      funext s
      have h₃ : p s.val := s.property
      have h₄ : (if h : p s.val then x₀ ⟨s.val, h⟩ else y ⟨s.val, by simpa [h] using Classical.by_contradiction (fun h' => by simp_all)⟩) = x₀ ⟨s.val, h₃⟩ := by
        simp [h₃]
      simp_all [Function.comp_apply]
      <;> aesop
    -- Construct the subtype element
    exact ⟨h₁, h₂⟩
  
  have h_forward_inverse : Function.LeftInverse h_forward h_inverse := by
    intro y
    -- Simplify the expression to show that applying h_forward to h_inverse(y) gives back y
    dsimp only [h_forward, h_inverse] at *
    -- Use function extensionality to compare the functions
    funext ⟨a, ha⟩
    -- Simplify the if-then-else expression using the fact that ¬p a
    by_cases h : p a <;> simp_all [h]
    <;> try { contradiction }
    <;> try { aesop }
  
  have h_inverse_forward : Function.RightInverse h_forward h_inverse := by
    intro f
    -- Simplify the expression to show that applying h_inverse to h_forward(f) gives back f
    dsimp only [h_forward, h_inverse] at *
    -- Use the property of f to simplify the if-then-else expression
    have h₁ : f.val ∘ Subtype.val = x₀ := f.property
    -- Use function extensionality to compare the functions
    have h₂ : (fun a => if h : p a then x₀ ⟨a, h⟩ else (fun ⟨a, ha⟩ => f.val a) ⟨a, by simpa [h] using Classical.by_contradiction (fun h' => by simp_all)⟩) = f.val := by
      funext a
      by_cases h₃ : p a <;> simp_all [h₃]
      <;>
      (try {
        have h₄ := congr_fun h₁ ⟨a, h₃⟩
        simp [Function.comp_apply] at h₄ ⊢
        <;> aesop
      }) <;>
      (try {
        aesop
      })
    -- Use the simplified expression to conclude the proof
    simp_all [Subtype.ext_iff]
    <;> aesop
  
  have h_main : {x : α → β // x ∘ Subtype.val = x₀} ≃ ({a : α // ¬p a} → β) := by
    refine' ⟨h_forward, h_inverse, _, _⟩
    · -- Prove that h_forward is the left inverse of h_inverse
      exact h_forward_inverse
    · -- Prove that h_inverse is the right inverse of h_forward
      exact h_inverse_forward
  
  exact h_main
